blogs.author: 6adf93f59756341515848425
blogs.content: When choosing a new smartphone, start with how you actually use your phone day to day. Heavy camera users should prioritize sensor size and computational photography features over raw megapixel counts. If battery life matters most, look for devices with larger cell capacity and efficient chipsets rather than the fastest processor on paper. For most buyers, a mid-range device from a reputable brand with timely software updates offers the best long-term value.
blogs.excerpt: Camera, battery, or performance — here is how to decide what actually matters for you.
blogs.title: A Buyer's Guide to Choosing Your Next Smartphone

blogs.author: 6adf93f59756341515848425
blogs.content: Tablets have closed much of the productivity gap with laptops thanks to better keyboard accessories and more capable apps, but a traditional laptop still wins for heavy multitasking, coding, and file management. If your coursework involves spreadsheets, video editing, or software development, a laptop remains the safer choice. For reading-heavy, note-taking-focused students, a tablet with a stylus can be a lighter, more versatile daily companion.
blogs.excerpt: We break down the real trade-offs between portability and productivity.
blogs.title: Laptop vs Tablet: What Should Students Buy in 2026?

blogs.author: 6adf93f59756341515848425
blogs.content: Avoid letting your battery sit at 0% or 100% for long periods — keeping it roughly between 20% and 80% slows down long-term wear. Skip overnight charging on cheap, uncertified chargers, and let your device cool down before charging if it has been running hot. Turning on battery saver mode during idle periods, lowering screen brightness, and closing background apps you are not using all add up over months of daily use.
blogs.excerpt: Small daily habits that add years to your device battery health.
blogs.title: 7 Simple Habits to Extend Your Gadget's Battery Life

pages.content:
Maroon is a modern electronics store offering smartphones, laptops, gadgets, and accessories with quality products, reliable service, and a simple shopping experience.

We partner directly with authorized distributors to guarantee every product is 100% genuine, backed by official warranty, and delivered quickly across Bangladesh at the best possible price.
pages.title: About Us

pages.content:
If you are not fully satisfied with your purchase, you may request a return or exchange within 7 days of delivery, provided the product is unused, in its original packaging, and accompanied by the original invoice.

Items marked as non-returnable, software, and personal-care accessories are not eligible for return unless defective on arrival. To start a return or exchange, contact our support team with your order number and reason for return.

Approved returns are collected via courier or can be dropped off at any Maroon store location. Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days of receiving the returned item.
pages.title: Return & Exchange Policy

pages.content:
## Warranty

Most products sold on Maroon include an official manufacturer or Maroon-backed warranty, shown on each product's detail page. Warranty covers manufacturing defects under normal use; physical damage, liquid damage, and unauthorized repairs are not covered.

## Shipping

Orders inside Dhaka are typically delivered within 1-2 business days, and 3-5 business days for locations outside Dhaka. Delivery charges are calculated at checkout based on your delivery area and are shown before you place your order.
pages.title: Warranty & Shipping Information

pages.content:
We collect the personal information you provide when creating an account or placing an order — name, email, phone number, and delivery address — solely to process your orders, provide customer support, and improve your shopping experience.

We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Payment details are processed securely by our payment partners and are never stored on our servers in plain text.
pages.title: Privacy Policy

pages.content:
By using Maroon and placing an order, you agree to provide accurate information, pay the listed price at checkout, and comply with our return, exchange, and warranty policies.

Product prices, availability, and promotions are subject to change without notice. Maroon reserves the right to cancel orders that appear fraudulent or cannot be verified.
